note: The files of the image definition of the HyperFrames engine (package V3a-image). The image's tag is openhora-hyperframes:<the first 12 characters of the sha256 of these files, by name and content, in sorted order>, so a file not listed here never changes the image or its tag and a listed one always does (review finding F11). Not listed, on purpose: hf_image.py (the build driver, outside the definition like the converter's container.py), README.md and NOTICE.md (documents). A file added to this folder is listed here or added to that sentence and to NOT_IN_DEFINITION of providers/renderer/tests/test_hf_image.py, or that test fails.
